primaryChange.title: Destiny 2 Update 6.3.0
primaryChange.heading: Tunnel Vision + Kill Clip
primaryChange.damageExcerpt: Reduced damage bonus from Kill Clip from 33% to 25%.
primaryChange.refreshExcerpt: refreshed if activated while already active.
supports: A qualifying activation can refresh an active buff

communityMeasurements.windowExcerpt: Finishing a reload within 3.6 seconds of a kill
communityMeasurements.stowExcerpt: Stowing the weapon removes the buff.
communityMeasurements.retrieval: Search-index body of the exact base hash's German page; research text is English. Direct English page fetch failed with HTTP 402 in the web tool.

enhancedComparison.warning: 5.5 seconds belongs to enhanced hash 2923251173, not base hash 1015611457.

reloadRules.windowEvent: Reload completion, measured from the weapon kill; starting a reload within 72 ticks is insufficient if completion is late.

manualReload.evidence: Official perk description plus community completion measurement

marksmanDodge.excerpt: Counts as a manual reload and will activate reload-triggered perks such as Kill Clip.
marksmanDodge.integrationPolicy: Call the activation hook at actual ammo transfer, with the same kill deadline; a dodge with no reload must not synthesize a reload event.
marksmanDodge.policyBoundary: The source classifies the dodge; it does not independently test full-magazine, zero-reserve or zero-transfer cases.

autoLoadingHolster.excerpt: Auto-Loading Holster does not trigger on-reload effects
autoLoadingHolster.limitation: Community wiki note, not an official Bungie assertion; the page's separate 3-second duration is not used.

shotgunFirstShell.integrationPolicy: Use the first successful shell insertion as the reload event and consume that kill eligibility once per reload sequence.
shotgunFirstShell.policyBoundary: Suggested adaptation to this project's progressive reload events. Retrieved sources do not settle first-shell versus final-shell activation or repeated-shell refresh; not verified Destiny behavior.

stowRules.suggestedIntegrationPolicy: Clear active buff and pending eligibility on stow; do not restore either on draw.
stowRules.policyBoundary: Only active-buff removal is evidenced. Clearing the pending kill window is a conservative integration choice, not a sourced mechanic.

refreshRules.qualifyingKillAndReloadWhileActive: Refresh active duration to the base 100 ticks from completion.
refreshRules.integrationPolicy: Consume the pending kill on activation; a reload with no new qualifying kill must not refresh.
refreshRules.policyBoundary: One-time consumption, tick endpoint inclusion, and repeated reloads from the same kill are not independently established by the retrieved sources.

damageBoundary: Community research excludes splash/explosive damage belonging to other perks. This does not prove that a rocket's own blast is excluded. Projectile snapshot timing is not established here.
limitations: Absolute times and stow cancellation are community measurements, not numeric Bungie manifest fields.
20 ticks per second is the project's conversion; Destiny tick-boundary inclusivity is not measured.
No live gameplay tests or exhaustive audit of later patches was performed.
Do not promote the explicitly labeled integration policies to verified Destiny facts.
